scope: Corollary 9.4 (The absolute Iitaka base and descent of the whole fiber) of the manuscript “Logarithmic Kodaira dimension and whole-fiber variation” (preprints/Logarithmic-Kodaira-dimension-and-whole-fiber-variation-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b1b750b309e5c5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 71-72. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The variety U in Corollary 9.2 is a birational model of the absolute Iitaka base of X. Inside C(X), the field C(W) is the relative algebraic closure of C(Y )C(U). Consequently the field C(T0) ⊂ C(Y ) in that Corollary agrees with the field obtained from Propositions 2.7 and 2.10 applied to the projective morphism f with empty original boundaries. In particular, inside the prescribed algebraic closure Ω of C(Y ), put b = C(T0). There is a finitely generated field Eb/b such that (9.2) Frac(Ω ⊗b Eb) ≃ Frac(Ω ⊗C(Y ) C(X)). 72 OPENAI Thus the whole geometric generic fiber of f is birationally defined over this specific field b, and Var(f) ≤ dim T0.
